citation: Denk et al. (2018), The Irregular Satellites of Saturn; Denk and Mottola, Cassini lightcurve modelling
gmInterpretation: Unmodeled mass, not measured physical zero
formula: Let rho(lon) be the positive intersection of the equatorial ray with the CCW convex polygon. r(lon,lat)=1/sqrt((cos(lat)/rho(lon))^2+(sin(lat)/polarSemiAxisKm)^2). This assumes geometrically similar cross-sections scaled by sqrt(1-(z/c)^2).
qualification: Approximate triangular shape from published 20, 24 and 25 km equatorial sides and an 8 km polar semiaxis. Polar caps and the initial meridian are assumed; the original inversion mesh is unavailable.

evidence.assumption: Elliptical polar cap law; dimensions are preserved, not rescaled to photometric mean radius. This is a coarse convex approximation, not a contact-binary reconstruction.
